plausibility.question: P1 gravity
plausibility.answer: Yes with the ties: foot down (+Y), saddles under the sleeve, load path saddle-web-foot-4 screws; but the pump's centre of mass (uniform-density model z 7.23; coil centre z 12.85) lies outside the saddle span z 15..31, so it stays seated only under tie tension (F2)

plausibility.question: P2 function chains
plausibility.answer: Tie path exists: slot, up the 2.30/2.65 gap between post and side plate, over the plate corner (r 31.41 at theta 210) and the sleeve top, down the other side; the −Y side at z 15.6..20.4 is coil only (r <= 23.72); the tie bears on the metal plates (F3)

plausibility.question: P3 motion clearance
plausibility.answer: No moving part; the vibrating pump keeps 2.300 (-X post), 2.650 (+X post), 2.788 (ribs to coil); insertion along +Y keeps >= 2.300 from -60 mm to the pose

plausibility.question: P4 human factors
plausibility.answer: A dia 5.5 driver cylinder straight down each hole clears OD-H01 by >= 4.05 mm; screw heads clear the post ends by 1.25 in z; the 6.0 x 2.5 slots and 2.30 gaps pass a 4.8 x 1.4 tie

plausibility.question: P5 absurdity
plausibility.answer: 80 x 52 x 40 mm, 31.96 g PETG cradle for a 0.5 kg vibratory pump: in proportion with OEM pump brackets

plausibility.question: P6 floating, embedded, mirrored, upside-down
plausibility.answer: Cradle is one solid, in the spec frame, saddle facing the pump; only the assumed sleeve model is embedded in the coil (1427.17 mm3, an A-03 model limit, F4)

findings.required: no unacceptable vibration to the chassis with the OEM sleeve fitted (bench)
findings.risk_basis: a Hard §5 row that no geometric check can answer; the evidence cannot tell, and F3 shows the ties bear on the metal frame, a path around the rubber sleeve
findings.fix_direction: no geometry change clears it: bench-test the first print with the OEM sleeve, or the Usta reclassifies REQ-09 in spec §5 as a post-print gate outside the CAD review

findings.required: pump centre of mass over the saddle span z 15.0..31.0
findings.at: (−0.07, −0.87, 7.23) uniform-density centre of mass of OD-H01; coil centre z 12.85
findings.risk_basis: the pump extends to z -66.45 on the outlet side while both saddles sit at z 15..31; seated only by tie tension (about 3 N static at the z 28 tie), rocking on the rib 1 edge under vibration is plausible
findings.fix_direction: spec: add a strapless saddle near z 0..6 (clear of the -Y features, which only constrain the strap path) or move rib 1 toward -Z so the span brackets the centre of mass

findings.required: tie rides on the sleeve (spec §4 C1)
findings.at: side plate corners (-27.2, -16.2) and (26.85, -16.2), r 31.41 at theta 210 over z 15.6..30.4
findings.risk_basis: the tie climbs the outer faces of the side plates in the 2.30/2.65 gaps and crosses their corners before the sleeve, so frame-tie-post is a path that bypasses the rubber; a closed loop through two side slots also has to cross the pump twice
findings.fix_direction: spec: route the strap under the saddle (slots in the foot or web) or add a rubber pad where the tie crosses the plate corners; confirm at the REQ-09 bench test

findings.required: clearance = 0, interference <= 0 against the A-03 sleeve
findings.risk_basis: the equality holds only at r 26.650 exactly (reviewer controls: 26.55 gives 24.51 mm3, 26.75 a 0.100 gap), FDM holds about +-0.1 to 0.2, and the sleeve model overlaps OD-H01 by 1427.17 mm3 as two separate arcs
findings.fix_direction: measure OD-H02 (retire A-03) and restate REQ-04 as a banded interference or gap the rubber tolerates

findings.risk_basis: margin 0.300 is below the scan p95 deviation 0.448 (A-01, max 2.49), so the real plate may sit inside 2.0
findings.fix_direction: calipers on the frame plates (A-01, A-04); if they read wider, move post_x_in outward in the spec

findings.required: >= 2.0 (also U-06 and REQ-05 ligament; REQ-05 clear 6.0 x 2.5; D-03a 45 deg)
findings.risk_basis: zero margin by the spec's own dimensions; a 2.0 ligament is five 0.4 perimeters and a 2.5 slot passes a 1.4 tie, so function does not hang on the last 0.1
findings.fix_direction: spec: 22.0 post block or 5.8-wide slots to give margin; none needed in the build

least_sure_answers.item: REQ-03 margin 0.300 at the -X post is below the scan p95 0.448 (A-01)
least_sure_answers.answer: Confirmed: 2.300 at (-29.5, 0.0, 13..33) to the -X plate x -27.20, +X 2.650; the insertion path keeps 2.300. Rated F5 MEDIUM; calipers retire it.

least_sure_answers.item: REQ-04 contact and the sleeve shape rest wholly on A-03; the assumed sleeve overlaps the coil by 1427.2 mm3
least_sure_answers.answer: Confirmed: contact 6.9e-13 on both saddles, interference 0.0; the sleeve model is two arcs sharing 1427.17 mm3 with OD-H01; +-0.10 on the radius gives 24.51 mm3 or 0.100 gap (F4).

least_sure_answers.item: Zero-margin rows: slot ligament 2.000, slot clear 6.0 x 2.5, gable roofs 45.000 deg; ties bear on the side plates
least_sure_answers.answer: Confirmed: ligaments 2.000 (min_wall 1.999999999999997), clear 6.000 x 2.500, roofs 45.000 deg, all inside the bands (F6 LOW); the tie path crosses the plate corners at r 31.41 (F3 MEDIUM).
